title: Independent verification: complete minimum-word census for dirty fanout stars (no new kappa)
head: df645942469e6a739ec94010a6068c398f4a6c86
body:
Independent verification / scoped equality-count result; **no new κ**.

PR889 proves that its one-connector, one-source dirty fanout needs `2k+2` signed queries. This package independently checks that minimum for `k=1..5` and counts **every** minimum-length labelled word: **4, 24, 288, 5,760, 172,800**. A written proof characterizes the equality cases and gives `2(k+1)(k!)²` for every `k>=1` within that alphabet.

The new checker uses exact integer coefficient states and a symmetry quotient retaining labelled-word multiplicities, with proved safe pruning. An unquotiented, unpruned implementation agrees at every length for `k=1,2`. A separate free-associative-algebra interpreter checks all arbitrary dirty input columns of 60 actual emitted recursive programs and their literal inverses; five one-factor batches additionally pass strict star-alphabet and single-connector admission. Only the predecessor's emitter is executed; no predecessor interpreter, census or invoice is imported.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.10+ and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/dirty-fanout-star-census/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/dirty-fanout-star-census/test_package.py
```

Expected marker: `PASS_STAR_CENSUS k=1..5 minima=4,6,8,10,12 counts=4,24,288,5760,172800 emitter_cases=60 star_cases=5 controls=6 no_new_kappa`; all **10 package tests** pass. Normal/optimized runs agree. Six built-in controls and package mutations detect restoration/sign/order/alias failures, lost label multiplicity, invalid model ports, omitted source pins, source drift and receipt corruption. Standalone relocation and unchanged default-output bytes pass. Selected-record integrity and all five existing selected-result tests pass on both bases.

Original base: `91a2094f2e022930069e8cfdc810a3ea1b81cd09`. Refreshed submission base: `47481c89fd30a43f8f882eb4b391e89c29273fd0`. Subject PR889: `e2021d1c9e06948528cbc0a8fd7079b671da981d`; three verbatim files have SHA256/Git-blob pins. During verification main selected PR890 at κ=`1661957774647029/10^18`; this package leaves that selection and `upstream/` unchanged. Only `research/dirty-fanout-star-census/` differs from refreshed main.

Seed **79**, independent-verification track. No pinned coordination issue exists; the local claim records three candidates, fixed coverage and stopping rule. The final queue refresh includes PR937. Concurrent PR934 extends PR889 to multiple sources and supplies optimal witnesses; this contribution adds the complete minimizer count for the one-source alphabet. PR896's nonlinear binary evaluator formalization is distinct. No superseded frontier or pending title is used as the accepted bound.

Credit **CubeJerry / PR889** for the batched interface and original restricted-query minimum, and **Chafik Boukhalfa / PR628** for the dirty-commutator lineage. Prepared for **@RossRichardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, including a delegated proof derivation/code review. Original notices and Apache-2.0 license are retained; no independent human review claimed.

The universal argument is a written mathematical proof, not proof-assistant formalization. Finite emitter checks do not establish all-size compilation, physical hosting/tape, rounded-leaf accuracy, supplier admission or the full multiplication theorem. No full repository regeneration, selected cold replay or hosted-CI success is claimed. There is no new supplier or exponent saving.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
